items.name: Assembly Line Logistics Container
items.description: Use this to store finished robots at the factory instead of shipping them to the station. Only useful if you want to put robots into workstations.

items.name: Battery (Small)
items.description: Stores power from the connected High-Voltage Grid and releases it when necessary.

items.name: Battery (Large)
items.description: Stores power from the connected High-Voltage Grid and releases it when necessary.

items.name: Biomass Burner
items.description: Burns Biomass to provide low voltage power to the foundation it is placed on.

items.name: Blast Furnace Base
items.description: Requires Hot Air, Coked Ignium, Mineral Rock and Xenoferrite/Technum Ore to produce Molten Metals, which are processed by Casting Machines or the Heavy Caster. Produces Slag as waste product which is processed by Chemical Processors.

items.name: Boiler
items.description: Burns fuel to generate Steam from Water, which can be used to power Steam Turbines.

items.name: Building Block
items.description: Most buildings require Building Blocks as a foundation. Building blocks also conduct low voltage power.

items.name: Burner Generator
items.description: Burns various fuel items to provide low voltage power to the foundation it is placed on.

items.name: Heavy Caster Base
items.description: Used together with the Blast Furnace to process molten metals.

items.name: Construction Ship Port
items.description: Required for constructing Modular Buildings. Houses construction ships that assemble Modular Buildings once enough materials have been delivered to the construction site.

items.name: Construction Warehouse
items.description: Required for constructing Modular Buildings. Stores materials that will be picked up by transport ships for delivery to construction sites.

items.name: Conveyor Balancer I
items.description: Splits, merges, or shuffles belts. Supports input/output belt priority settings and item type filtering.

items.name: Conveyor Balancer II
items.description: Splits, merges, or shuffles belts. Supports input/output belt priority settings and item type filtering.

items.name: Conveyor Balancer III
items.description: Splits, merges, or shuffles belts. Supports input/output belt priority settings and item type filtering.

items.name: Conveyor Balancer IV
items.description: Splits, merges, or shuffles belts. Supports input/output belt priority settings and item type filtering.

items.name: Data Source (Button)
items.description: On button push the configured signals will be pulsed once.

items.name: Decor (Windows Modular Slope Edge)
items.description: Use these blocks to transition between straight and sloped modular windows.

items.name: Decor (Windows Modular Wedge)
items.description: _base_decor_window_wedge_corner_iii

items.name: Drill Ship
items.description: Tunnel boring vehicle. Excels at digging tunnels, but can be useful for various excavation projects.

items.name: Excavation Drone Controller
items.description: Use this tool to mark areas for excavation by either your personal mining drones or the modular building construction ships (not unlocked together).

items.name: Drone Miner I
items.description: Mines ore patches when placed close to them. Cannot mine the larger ore veins.

items.name: Drone Miner II
items.description: Mines ore patches when placed close to them. Cannot mine the larger ore veins.

items.name: Cargo Shuttle Start Pad
items.description: Transports items to a Cargo Shuttle Target Pad of your choice. For planetary transport only.

items.name: Cargo Shuttle Start Pad (Liquids)
items.description: Transports items to a Cargo Shuttle Target Pad of your choice. For planetary transport only.

items.name: Cargo Shuttle Target Pad
items.description: Receives items from Cargo Shuttle Start Pads. Can receive from multiple Start Pads. For planetary transport only.

items.name: Cargo Shuttle Target Pad (Liquids)
items.description: Receives items from Cargo Shuttle Start Pads. Can receive from multiple Start Pads. For planetary transport only.

items.name: Elevator
items.description: Character elevator which also conducts high voltage power between all stations. Once placed, configure the other stations from its screen panel. Can automatically dig out the elevator shaft.

items.name: Xeno-Crystal-Extractor
items.description: Mines Xeno-Crystals when placed on top of a crystal deposit. Xeno Power Cores and Robot Workstations can be used to increase its output drastically.

items.name: Xeno-Scrap-Extractor
items.description: Mines Xeno-Scrap when placed on top of a scrap deposit. Xeno Power Cores and Robot Workstations can be used to increase its output drastically.

items.name: Omni-Analyzer
items.description: Allows to analyze collectibles like scrap and crystals to unlock upgrades.

items.name: Explosives
items.description: Precursor item for remotely detonated charges.

items.name: Firmarlite Bar
items.description: Made from Firmarlite Bars in a Lava Smelter.

items.name: Flare Stack
items.description: Destroys any liquid/gas inserted. Primarily used for burning of waste products.

items.name: Fracking Tower Base
items.description: Needs to be placed on top of an ore vein to convert it into an infinite ore source. Requires Fracking Liquid.

items.name: Freight Elevator I
items.description: Can vertically move items both up and down simultaneously, requires Loaders at both ends. Once upper and lower parts are placed, will automatically dig the ground in-between.

items.name: Freight Elevator II
items.description: Can vertically move items both up and down simultaneously, requires Loaders at both ends. Once upper and lower parts are placed, will automatically dig the ground in-between.

items.name: Freight Elevator III
items.description: Can vertically move items both up and down simultaneously, requires Loaders at both ends. Once upper and lower parts are placed, will automatically dig the ground in-between.

items.name: Freight Elevator IV
items.description: Can vertically move items both up and down simultaneously, requires Loaders at both ends. Once upper and lower parts are placed, will automatically dig the ground in-between.

items.name: Geothermal Boiler
items.description: Consumes Ignium-Enriched Water to create Steam for Steam Turbines. Needs to be placed on a Geothermal Vent.

items.name: Incinerator
items.description: Destroys any item inserted.

items.name: Loader
items.description: Moves items from belts to buildings when configured as input or from buildings to belts when configured as output.

items.name: Filter Loader
items.description: Moves items from belts to buildings when configured as input or from buildings to belts when configured as output. Supports configuring a filter item type, and will then only move the set item type.

items.name: Loader (2nd Lane)
items.description: Moves items from belts to buildings when configured as input or from buildings to belts when configured as output.

items.name: Loader (3rd Lane)
items.description: Moves items from belts to buildings when configured as input or from buildings to belts when configured as output.

items.name: Xeno-Logistics Tower
items.description: Extends the coverage of your Xeno-Logistics Network, which teleports requested items from Xeno-Logistics-Containers into your inventory. Item requests can be configured at your inventory frame.

items.name: Modular Building Planner
items.description: Required to construct and configure Modular Buildings.

items.name: Modular Storage Tank Base
items.description: Stores large amounts of liquids or gases.

items.name: Monument Base
items.description: A decorative monument.

items.name: Orbital Uplink
items.description: Allows for remote access to all of the Space Station's features.

items.name: Ore Vein Miner
items.description: Mines ore seams of Ore Veins. Cannot mine the smaller ore patches.

items.name: Paint Roller
items.description: Can be used to change the color of certain objects and buildings that support this feature.

items.name: Xeno-Logistics Container
items.description: Stores items to be used for resupply in your Xeno-Logistics Network. See Xeno-Logistics Tower for more details.

items.name: Pipe
items.description: Moves liquids or gases. Requires a pump when the pipe length exceeds the limit.

items.name: Liquid Intake
items.description: Draws in Water when placed submerged.

items.name: Pipeline
items.description: Moves liquids or gases at higher rates than pipes. Requires a pipeline pump when the pipeline length exceeds the limit.

items.name: Liquid Intake (Pipeline)
items.description: Draws in Water when placed submerged.

items.name: Plumber Tool
items.description: Allows you to discard a pipe network’s contents.

items.name: Power Line
items.description: Use this item to build your high-voltage power grid, also requires Power Poles in your inventory unless you just want to connect existing objects.

items.name: Power Pole (Small)
items.description: Extends the reach of the High-Voltage Grid. Use Power Lines for a convenient way of placing both Power Poles and Power Lines together.

items.name: Power Pole (Large)
items.description: Extends the reach of the High-Voltage Grid. Use Power Lines for a convenient way of placing both Power Poles and Power Lines together.

items.name: Power Pole (Wall-Mounted)
items.description: Extends the reach of the High-Voltage Grid. Use Power Lines for a convenient way of placing both Power Poles and Power Lines together.

items.name: Pipe-to-Pipeline Pump
items.description: Pumps pipe contents into a pipeline.

items.name: Pipeline-to-Pipe Pump
items.description: Pumps pipeline contents into a pipe.

items.name: Pump (Pipelines)
items.description: Required once a pipeline network exceeds the complexity limit. Can also be used to create a one-way flow.

items.name: Pump (Pipes)
items.description: Required once a pipe network exceeds the complexity limit. Can also be used to create a one-way flow.

items.name: Pumpjack I
items.description: Extracts Olumite when placed above an Olumite Reservoir.

items.name: Quarry
items.description: Automatically excavates areas. Excels at digging shafts or pits, but can be useful for various excavation projects.

items.name: Radio Tower Base
items.description: Allows contacting the space station remotely with the Orbital Uplink tool.

items.name: Scrap Recycler
items.description: Extracts components from Xeno-Scrap.

items.name: Resource Separator
items.description: Extracts resources from terrain blocks and seeds.

items.name: Research Server
items.description: Analyzes Science Packs to research new technologies. Using multiple increases research speed.

items.name: Long Range Scanner
items.description: Scans for ores and reservoirs within a very large radius.

items.name: Shipping Pad (Small)
items.description: Transports items to or from the space station. Requires an available space ship on the station.

items.name: Shipping Pad (Medium)
items.description: Transports items to or from the space station. Requires an available space ship on the station.

items.name: Shipping Pad (Medium, Assembly Line)
items.description: Transports items to or from the space station. Requires an available space ship on the station.

items.name: Advanced Smelter
items.description: Automatically smelts inserted ores.

items.name: Lava-Smelter I
items.description: Smelts Firmarlite Bars into Firmarlite Sheets. Needs to be placed on lava.

items.name: Lava-Smelter II
items.description: Smelts Firmarlite Bars into Firmarlite Sheets. Needs to be placed on lava.

items.name: Smelter (Small)
items.description: Automatically smelts inserted ores.

items.name: Solar Panel (Small)
items.description: Generates high voltage power for the connected high-voltage grid while exposed to sunlight.

items.name: Solar Panel (Large)
items.description: Generates high voltage power for the connected high-voltage grid while exposed to sunlight.

items.name: Space Station Terminal
items.description: Contact your space station from here.

items.name: Train Loading Station
items.description: Loading Stations are extensions to Train Stations where a wagon can be loaded or unloaded. Each wagon needs its own loading station.

items.name: Train Station
items.description: Trains can stop here.

items.name: Transformer (Small)
items.description: When placed on a foundation, supplies it with low voltage power drawn from the high-voltage grid.

items.name: Transformer (Large)
items.description: When placed on a foundation, supplies it with low voltage power drawn from the high-voltage grid.

items.name: Transport Ship Port
items.description: Required for constructing Modular Buildings. Houses transport ships that move materials from Construction Warehouses to construction sites.

items.name: Steam Turbine
items.description: Consumes Steam to generate high voltage power for the connected high-voltage grid.

items.name: Irrigation Tool
items.description: Can be used on various terrain blocks to regrow grass or similar features.

items.name: Robot Workstation I
items.description: Robots can work here to improve various machines.

items.name: Robot Workstation II
items.description: Robots can work here to improve various machines.

items.name: Robot Workstation III
items.description: Robots can work here to improve various machines.

items.name: Train Tanker Wagon
items.description: For liquids and gases.

items.name: Train Cargo Wagon
items.description: For solid items.
